title: Sharp one-dimensional Lieb–Thirring constants
summary: We resolve affirmatively the remaining cases of the scalar one-dimensional Lieb–Thirring conjecture: for every $`\frac12\lt \gamma\lt \frac32`$, the optimal constant is the one-bound-state constant. The estimate holds for every nonnegative potential in $`L^{\gamma+1/2}(\mathbb R)`$, with all negative eigenvalues included.
family_title: Sharp finite-matrix Lieb–Thirring inequalities and all equality cases

review.reason: Establishes optimal one-dimensional Lieb–Thirring constants for a range of exponents.
